visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a white paper cup containing light brown milk tea and numerous glistening dark brown boba pearls. A hand holding a silver pitcher pours more tea into the cup, causing small bubbles to form on the surface. (2) The scene cuts to a different cup where a stream of dark tea is poured into a mixture of white milk and ice, creating a marbled visual effect. A metal ladle is then shown scooping up dark amber, translucent jelly toppings from a white container. (3) A person wearing blue latex gloves pours fresh milk from a Ruisui brand carton into a clear measuring cup. The background features a clean, industrial-style kitchen or shop setting with stainless steel equipment and bright lighting. (4) Preparation of fruit tea follows, showing yellow liquid being poured into a shaker and passion fruit seeds being added with a long spoon. The drinks are then shown in their final presentation with vibrant yellow and orange colors. (5) A person's hands hold two branded white cups against a blurred outdoor background of a street. A hand-to-hand exchange of a plastic bag containing the drinks occurs between two people. (6) The final scene shows the exterior of a shop named 'Jilin Ti' under bright daylight, with a white sign and a minimalist tree logo on a yellow-painted building.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming pattern. A friendly male voice starts narrating in Traditional Chinese with high clarity. A subtle sound of liquid pouring into a cup is heard. (2) As the narrator describes the toppings, a soft percussive sound of a ladle hitting a container is audible. The BGM remains steady and upbeat, driving the energetic mood. (3) The voice becomes slightly more emphatic when mentioning the milk brand. The sound of milk rushing into a container adds a soft white-noise texture to the mix. (4) A short 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between drink types. The acoustic guitar continues its major-mode progression. (5) A clinking sound of ice against a shaker is heard as the narrator introduces the fruit teas. The speech rate remains consistently fast and informative. (6) The narration concludes with a friendly call to action and a brand slogan. The BGM fades slightly at the end, followed by a moment of clean digital silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase -> Menu Variety -> Location Info/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for a tea shop named Jilin Ti in Kaohsiung. It uses highly appetizing close-up visuals of boba and jelly preparation, combined with energetic narration, to showcase the quality of ingredients and variety of drinks available, ultimately encouraging viewers to visit or order delivery.
